newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moslem fundamentalists kill eight Algerian civilians.
newsitem.headline: Moslem fundamentalists kill eight Algerian civilians.

text.p: Moslem fundamentalists killed eight civilians overnight in Blida province south of Algiers, bringing to 37 the numver of civilians killed in less than a week, Algerian security forces said on Tuesday.
In a statement carried by the official APS news agency, the security forces said the eight civilians were "killed by a group of terrorists" in the village of Amroussa.
It described them as having been killed "in a cowardly way", an expresion used by Algerian authorities when the victims have had their throats slit.
Amroussa lies not far from Benachour and Boufarik villages where 29 civilians had been killed in a similar way in two attacks last week.
The three villages are located in the province of Blida, whose provincial capital is both the headquarters of Algeria's number one military region and a bastion of radical Moslem fundamentalism.
The city of Blida is 50 km (30 miles) south of the capital Algiers.
In its midday news bulletin, the Algerian public station "Algerian TV" annouced the massacre in a brief statement. It showed no pictures of the victims.
Algerian authorities have blamed Moslem fundamentalists for a series of massacres of civilians in the past two months, usually in isolated villages during the night.
About 60,000 people have died in Algeria's violence since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
